title: [PrismOcclusion] could not measure a circumscribing radius for vessel 'Jacks(Clone)' — it has no MeshFilter/SkinnedMeshR
notes: Fix 2026-11-20 by claude (ba3ad0569a): Same cause as the Serpent (E-5f2ee86d9b): the Jacks' hull was not shown yet when the vessel was bound. PrismOcclusionCorridor.Publish measures an unmeasured hull again until it shows.
signature: Error|[PrismOcclusion] could not measure a circumscribing radius for vessel 'Jacks(Clone)' — it has no MeshFilter/SkinnedMeshRenderer hull outside its skimmers. sample: [PrismOcclusion] could not measure a circumscribing radius for vessel 'Jacks(Clone)' — it has no MeshFilter/SkinnedMeshRenderer hull outside its skimmers. The occlusion corridor is sized from the vessel's own hull, so it has fallen back to PrismOcclusionConfig.fallbackVesselRadius (6). Give the vessel a renderable hull, or the corridor around it is a guess. Docs/PRISM_ANIMATION.md §4.7.
